The Band

Born on a festival stage.

Etta and the Vendetta is a soul, funk and rock band based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, led by the powerful and soulful vocals of Etta McKinley.

The band came together in the summer of 2023 for a Juneteenth Festival performance — and kept going. Since then they've played rooms and stages across Sioux Falls, including Trio Jazz Club, the Icon, and the Levitt Shell — most recently opening for Dustbowl Revival at Levitt at the Falls.
